title: One live board (POST /api/tournaments/:slug/live body)
description: Sender: Alnasl (Alnasl.Games.body/3 via Alnasl.Outbox), one board per request. Headers: Authorization: Bearer <relay key orrk_... | operator ingest token | owning installation key>; X-OpenResults-Key: the tournament's key once claimed, NOT with a relay key; Content-Type: application/json. The tournament must have published and the (round, board) must be in its current snapshot (409 board_not_published). Keyed by (slug, round, board) and decided by ply count, so a resend is always safe. Unknown fields are ignored (additionalProperties true). Prose: docs/live-boards-api.md. Several boards at once: live-board-batch.request.schema.json.

board.description: The board number as the snapshot numbers it (rounds[].boards[].board): in a team event the round-wide number, not the board within the match.

moves.description: The WHOLE game so far, every time: SAN, from the start position or from start_fen. Read leniently (missing x or +/#, 0-0, e8Q, unneeded disambiguation); stored canonically. Each 2-12 bytes.

fen.description: The current position. With moves, a check they agree (422 fen_mismatch); alone, the game is shown without a move list and ply is required.

ply.description: PLIES (half-moves) played, not full moves. Required with fen alone; with moves it must equal their count (422 ply_mismatch).

start_fen.description: For a game not from the standard position. No Chess960 castling.

white_ms.description: White's clock in MILLISECONDS as it reads at the moment of this report.

running.description: Whose clock runs: white, black, or none / null when neither. "stopped" is accepted as a synonym of none. Absent leaves the held value alone.

status.description: Default live. A game reported finished stays finished.

result.description: The relay's suggestion, shown as provisional; only meaningful with status finished. The published result always wins.

replace.description: true: a full resend that replaces whatever is held, whatever its ply.
